data.long_meaning: Chandra (Moon) - Mada (god) - Dhava (treasure) Chandramadhav is the name of Lord Vishnu, who holds the moon in his hand as a symbol of his power over the cycles of time. The name Chandramadhav carries the meaning “Moon God's treasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chandramadhav usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Chandramadhav" holds great significance in Hindu mythology, as it is a combination of two powerful deities - the moon (Chandra) and the preserver god, Lord Vishnu (Madhava). The sign of the moon in Lord Vishnu's hand is an auspicious symbol, invoking the wisdom, protection, and divine blessings of these powerful deities. The place of occurrence for the name Chandramadhav in Hindu epics and scriptures suggests that the name carries connotations of divinity, power, and fortune.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Chandramadhav" embodies the spiritual search for knowledge, prosperity, and the grace of divine deities. The association of the moon with the name reminds us of the cyclic nature of life, while the name Madhava underscores the importance of being the 'treasurer' of knowledge and virtue. The spiritual significance of this name is a reminder to seek knowledge, preserve it, and use it for the betterment of our own lives and those of the people around us, while remaining humble and grateful for the divine blessings bestowed upon us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Chandramadhav: Moon (Chandra) is the embodiment of peace and tranquility. Madhav, an alternative name for Lord Krishna, symbolizes love, compassion, and divine joy. Together, "Chandramadhav" signifies a harmonious blend of inner peace and divine love.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Chandramadhav was a king of the Vedic period in India. The name Chandramadhav carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Chandramadhav ruled over a kingdom in ancient India during the Vedic period.
